title: Compose typed evaluation claims without opaque scores
narrative: Taloneth starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Taloneth needs evaluators to emit independent pass/fail/unknown claims backed by evidence refs, not a single opaque score that hides which assertion failed. Accepts Anthropic eval guidance and BINEVAL[^anth-evals-claims][^arxiv-bineval].
implementation: `Evidence`, `Claim`, and `compose_claims` in `mechaharness.eval_evidence` provide typed evidence pointers and binary assertion composition.
validation: Harness `user_story` drives product verb(s) with environment `pass_through`/`mock`; hard expects on declared observation keys.

footnotes.label: Anthropic Demystifying evals for AI agents
